e: Led by Professor X and Cyclops, the X-Men protect a world that fears them from Sentinels, Magneto and Apocalypse.
Spider-Man comes looking for a cure for his mutation, scuffles with the X-Men, and learns Xavier cannot cure him.
Rogue flirts with Spider-Man at the mansion, and Wolverine joins his hunt for the missing Beast.
places.note: Marvel Database places the school in Salem Center, Westchester County; its Salem Center page makes that a hamlet of North Salem, NY, so the pin is North Salem's coordinates. The X-Men: The Animated Series#10 entry is the old whole-show entry from the u-animx pin (tagged #10 by ep_tags), moved here with its text unchanged. Scott and Jean's wedding (part of the A:fox-anim-x-men step tagged X-Men: The Animated Series#26) happens in episode 14, and no source I found names the venue, so I did not add an entry for it.

e: Genosha lures mutants with the promise of a haven, then collars them as slaves to build Sentinels, until the X-Men free them.
Magneto gathers his mutant army on Genosha, then calls off the attack when he learns Xavier has been struck down.
The council asks Magneto and Rogue to lead Genosha, but Sentinels strike its UN gala and kill thousands, Gambit among them.
As the X-Men help with the recovery, Emma Frost is pulled alive from the rubble, still in her diamond form.
The Wild Sentinel that slaughtered Genosha's mutants turns out to be Bastion's work.
Sentinels wipe out the mutant nation of Genosha, and Magneto takes the world hostage.
Psylocke is among the mutants in Genosha's ruins who stand against Bastion's Prime Sentinels.
Banned in the United States, the X-Men follow Xavier to Genosha's ruins, where he founds X-Corp.
places.note: The shows only say 'off the coast of Africa' (Marvel Animated wiki). Wikipedia puts Genosha off the southeastern African coast, southwest of the Seychelles and northeast of Madagascar, so the pin sits in the sea between the two. Hammer Bay is the capital Marvel Database lists for the X-Men '97 episodes. The X-Men '97#9 entry is the old whole-show entry from the u-animx pin (sub was 'Genosha', tagged #9 by ep_tags), moved here with its text unchanged; its 'takes the world hostage' half happens from Asteroid M. The A:fox-anim-gambit step tagged X-Men: The Animated Series#12 also mentions freeing Genosha's slaves; that is episode 7, already covered by the #7 entry here, so the step is listed under Washington, D.C. only.

places.note: The animated shows only say Antarctica. CHECK: the Earth map (atlBounds) only draws down to 58 deg S, so this real position falls below the bottom of the map; the owner may want to clamp it to the bottom edge (about [-57, -68.5]) or extend the map. places.note: The show calls it a small island off the coast of Scotland (Marvel Animated wiki). The pin uses Marvel Database's location: just north of Cape Wrath. Proteus Part II plays mostly in Edinburgh, which the entry text names; I did not make a separate Edinburgh place. The X-Men: The Animated Series#10 entry is for the two steps in already.json (A:fox-anim-rogue and T:fox-anim-war) that were going to be tagged to the u-animx pin's #10 entry; they are listed in steps here with a 'from' marker.

e: Magneto opens his orbiting haven to mutants, but Fabian Cortez seizes it, captures and tortures Gambit, and fires missiles at Earth.
Magneto restores his orbiting haven and turns his back on Earth, and Rogue and Sunspot join him there.
Bastion tries to crash the asteroid into Earth, until U.S. missiles strike it and kill him.
places.note: Off-world: Asteroid M is Magneto's station in Earth orbit (Marvel Database lists it under Earth Orbit), and no source puts it over a particular spot. Per the owner's rule it sits on the map edge: the top edge, at Genosha's longitude, because both shows tie it to Genosha (in X-Men: The Animated Series Magneto frees Genosha's mutants while building it; in X-Men '97 he re-founds his haven there after Genosha falls). That choice of longitude is mine. The Sanctuary two-parter is episodes 48 and 49 by Wikipedia's numbering; the entry uses #53 because the input steps (which also cover the Germany ski trip) are tagged #53. The X-Men '97#9 entry is for the A:fox-anim-sunspot step in already.json that was going to be tagged to the u-animx pin's #9 entry.
